_about: Which organization names a document names are too generic to give a running enumeration as leads. Documents name offices and services ('Counseling', 'Health Center', 'Rapid Response') as if they were organizations; given to the engine, such a name matches unrelated bodies in the registries and funding records. A name is generic when it has none of entity_forms (a word that makes it the name of a particular body: an institution type) and no legal form of org_names.json (Inc, LLC, GmbH) and every word in it, other than particles, is one of generic_words. A generic name is still stored as a finding on its document; it just does not become a lead. Words are compared lower-cased, without surrounding punctuation.
